mentions.name: leptos-native
mentions.description: A native UI framework in Rust for building cross-platform, fully native applications with platform-native components. It builds on Leptos's declarative UI syntax and reactive elements and works on iOS, Cocoa and GTK, though it is not officially part of Leptos. The core is being rewritten to split the app backend API from a separate platform layer, with plans to run apps written in WASM on Windows/Mac/Linux hosts using native UI, a runner to run any app as a TUI, and a compilation process producing a single native process for app developers to publish to the App Store.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a native UI framework in rust. I want to be able to build cross platform, fully native applications with native code. And I want platform native components.
mentions.author: josephg
